# Art3ry

> Art3ry (Art3ry, LLC, California) builds and runs the complete business system for small businesses: website and professional email, Google Business Profile, SEO, visibility in AI search (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), organic and paid marketing, an AI phone assistant that answers and qualifies every call, lead follow-up, quotes, invoicing and getting paid. It is one person, Jesse Moraga, who does all of the work himself with no outsourcing, and takes on five to eight client businesses at a time. Remote, anywhere in the United States, based in California.

Key facts:

- Owner and operator: Jesse Moraga (https://jessemoraga.com). He built the system and runs his own companies on it, including a California field-services company.
- What a client gets: the whole chain from the first search to the money in their account, built around how their customers become customers.
- Who it is for: small businesses that already have customers, of any kind: barbers, salons, contractors, home services, law offices, real estate, restaurants, food trucks, clinics, shops, e-commerce.
- Capacity: five to eight clients at a time. No account managers, no offshore work.
- Pricing: scoped per business after a free diagnostic. No public price list.
- Contact: jesse@jessemoraga.com or https://art3ry.com/get-started/

## Services

- [The full system, front to back](https://art3ry.com/services/): every piece in order, presence, getting found, marketing, intake, getting paid
- [Websites](https://art3ry.com/services/websites/): small business websites built to book work
- [SEO](https://art3ry.com/services/seo/): ranking on Google and the map pack for what customers search
- [AI search visibility](https://art3ry.com/services/ai-search/): showing up when people ask ChatGPT, Claude or Google AI who is the best in their city
- [Marketing](https://art3ry.com/services/marketing/): organic content and social, Google and Facebook paid ads, email marketing
- [AI phone assistant](https://art3ry.com/services/ai-phone-assistant/): answers every call 24/7, qualifies the caller, captures name, phone, email and request
- [Lead capture and follow-up](https://art3ry.com/services/lead-follow-up/): every call, text, form and email caught and followed up in minutes
- [Automation and invoicing](https://art3ry.com/services/automation/): quotes, invoices with pay buttons, payment reminders, status updates, review requests
- [Google Business Profile optimization](https://art3ry.com/google-business-profile-optimization/)
- [Web design in Fresno](https://art3ry.com/web-design-fresno/) and [SEO company in Fresno](https://art3ry.com/seo-company-fresno/)
- [California service areas](https://art3ry.com/california/)
